at attractive prices. We drive customer traffic through the effective use of both print media as well as digital
communications.

advertisements and other targeted promotional offers through carrier delivery and direct mail. The consistency
and reach of our print advertising programs drive sales and create high customer awareness of the name “Big 5
SportingGoods.”
We use our own professional in-house advertising staff to generate our advertisements, including
design, layout, production and media management. Our in-house advertising department provides management

and mailers. We are able to effectively target different population zones for our advertising expenditures. We
place inserts in over 225 newspapers throughout our markets,supplemented in many areas by mailer distributions

Distribution
We operate a distribution center located in Riverside, California, that services all of our stores. The

We also operate a small distribution hub in Oregon to help mitigate fuel costs. This 12,000 squarefoot facility enables us to ship full trailers of product from our Riverside distribution center to the Pacific
Northwest, where we separate products for regional delivery. This distribution hub has greatly reduced the
number of transportation miles logged to distribute our product to the Pacific Northwest.

retailer in the western United States,operating 434 stores and a ne-commerce platform under the“Big5Sporting

store format that averages approximately 11,000 square feet. Our product mix includes athletic shoes, apparel
